subject.title: fix(agents): persist user turn before attempt failures

question: After comparing the rebased branch with current main's UserTurnTranscriptRecorder, does any unique CLI or ACP pre-attempt persistence gap remain that should be landed from this PR?
rationale: The branch is proven but conflict-dirty, and current main has since adopted a broader persistence owner and retry-suppression architecture; deciding whether to preserve a narrow remainder or close as implemented requires an owner-level comparison of durable transcript semantics.

options.title: Rebase and narrow
options.body: Preserve only a demonstrably missing CLI or ACP failure path and remove recorder, retry, and transcript-target logic already owned by current main.

options.title: Close as implemented
options.body: If current main already persists the accepted user turn exactly once on both CLI and ACP failures with internal transcript isolation, close this PR and the linked issue with fix provenance.

options.title: Pause the branch
options.body: Leave the PR open but unlanded until a transcript/session owner can validate the merge result and ownership boundary.

recommendation.title: Rebase and narrow
recommendation.body: Preserve only a demonstrably missing CLI or ACP failure path and remove recorder, retry, and transcript-target logic already owned by current main.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most directly ties this person to the current runtime-owned transcript persistence boundary and its landed retry semantics.
